g.text: dac-cv: 8 x CV out (D36). Vout = 6 Vdac - 5 V (Rf 30k, Rg 10k, Roff 15k, 0.1 %); 1k inside the loop, 1 nF HF feedback

g.text: JP2 ADDR: GND 0x48 (as built), 3.3 V 0x4A, open 0x4C. JP1 LDAC: GND (immediate update, as built) or SYNC.

g.text: DAC on the bus's 3.3 V, 2.5V ref 2.5 V on VREFIN (internal reference off). Outputs at -5 V until the controller sets them.
